# okstatus_private_agents (Data Source)

The private agents of the org that owns the configured API key — the probes you run on your own network. Read-only: an agent is enrolled from the dashboard, since enrolling hands out a credential. Use an agent's `region` in the `regions` of an `okstatus_monitor` to run that monitor on it. Enrollment tokens and credentials are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okstatus_private_agents" "all" {}

# Run a monitor on one agent, picked by its name.
locals {
  paris_agent = one([for a in data.okstatus_private_agents.all.agents : a if a.name == "dc-paris"])
}

resource "okstatus_monitor" "intranet" {
  name    = "Intranet"
  url     = "https://intranet.example.com"
  regions = [local.paris_agent.region]
}

output "outdated_agents" {
  value = [
    for a in data.okstatus_private_agents.all.agents : a.name
    if a.version != data.okstatus_private_agents.all.latest_version
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) One entry per agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))
- `eligible` (Boolean) Whether the org's plan includes private agents.
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier — this data source has no single ID of its own, required by the Terraform plugin framework.
- `latest_version` (String) Latest published version of the agent, to compare with each agent's `version`.
- `limit` (Number) Number of private agents the plan allows.
- `total` (Number) Number of private agents in the org.

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `last_heartbeat_at` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `platform` (String)
- `region` (String) Value to put in a monitor's `regions` to run it on this agent (`private:<id>`).
- `site` (String) Where the agent runs, as entered at enrollment.
- `status` (String) `up`, `degraded`, `offline`, `suspended` or `pending` (not enrolled yet).
- `suspended` (Boolean)
- `version` (String)
